panel.bin_missing: {bin} is not installed, or is not on the PATH Noctalia runs with. See the plugin README.
panel.empty_deploys_body: None of the followed repositories has a successful deployment.
panel.empty_issues_body: No open issue is assigned to you.
panel.empty_prs_body: You have no open pull or merge request.
panel.empty_reviews_body: No pull or merge request is waiting for your review.
panel.gh_auth_missing: gh is installed but not signed in. Run `gh auth login` in a terminal, then refresh.
panel.gitea_auth_missing: gt has no account on your Gitea instance. Run `gt auth login` in a terminal, then refresh.
panel.gitlab_scope_missing: GitLab needs a repository or a group to list your merge requests and issues.
panel.no_tabs: Every tab is hidden. Enable one in the plugin settings.
panel.title: Git Companion

service.gh_auth_missing: gh is not signed in. Run `gh auth login`.
service.gitea_auth_missing: gt is not signed in. Run `gt auth login`.
service.gitlab_scope_missing: GitLab requires a repo or group scope in settings.

merge_status.need_rebase: {ref} is out of date with its target branch

service.title: Git Companion

bar_display_mode.description: Choose what text to show next to the icon in the bar.
bar_display_mode.label: Bar Display Mode

branch_badge.description: Choose which target branch to display in a colored badge.

count_reviews_with_prs.description: Add reviews to the PR/MR count in the bar. The tooltip always lists both.
count_reviews_with_prs.label: Count Code Reviews with PRs/MRs

deploy_hidden_envs.description: Environments left out of the Deploys tab: one name per entry (prod), or a prefix ending in * (bot-*).
deploy_hidden_envs.label: Hidden Environments

deploy_repos.description: Repositories shown in the Deploys tab: owner/repo (GitHub) or project path (GitLab). Empty uses Repository; with neither, the tab is hidden.
deploy_repos.label: Deployment Repositories

group.description: Filter by group (GitLab) or owner (GitHub, Gitea). Leave empty to use repo.
group.label: Group / Owner

notify_mr_changes_requested.description: Notify when a reviewer requests changes on one of your pull/merge requests.
notify_mr_changes_requested.label: Notify: Changes Requested

notify_mr_conflict.description: Notify when one of your pull/merge requests has conflicts or falls behind its target branch.
notify_mr_conflict.label: Notify: Conflict or Out of Date

notify_mr_mergeable.description: Notify when one of your pull/merge requests can be merged.
notify_mr_mergeable.label: Notify: Ready to Merge

notify_mr_pipeline_failed.description: Notify when the CI of one of your pull/merge requests fails.
notify_mr_pipeline_failed.label: Notify: CI Failed

refresh_interval.description: How often to fetch updates from the API.
refresh_interval.label: Refresh Interval (seconds)

repo.description: e.g. owner/repo (GitHub, Gitea) or project path (GitLab). Leave empty to use group/owner.
repo.label: Repository

show_deploys.description: Show the tab listing the last successful deployment of each environment.
show_deploys.label: Show Deploys tab

show_issues.description: Show the tab listing the issues assigned to you.
show_issues.label: Show Issues tab

show_prs.description: Show the tab listing the pull/merge requests you authored.
show_prs.label: Show PRs/MRs tab

show_reviews.description: Show the tab listing open pull/merge requests awaiting your review.
show_reviews.label: Show Code Review tab

tab_style.description: Simple shows the tab names, Full adds their icons, Compact keeps the icons and counts only.
tab_style.label: Tab Style
